key.name: copy
key.description: Sends Ctrl+C to the focused window, or Ctrl+Shift+C when the window is a terminal (see terminal-wm-classes).

key.name: paste
key.description: Sends Ctrl+V to the focused window, or Ctrl+Shift+V when the window is a terminal (see terminal-wm-classes).

key.name: cut
key.description: Sends Ctrl+X to the focused window, or Ctrl+Shift+X when the window is a terminal (see terminal-wm-classes).

key.name: open-history
key.description: Opens the clipboard history popup. <Mod5> is AltGr on a layout with level3(ralt_switch).

key.name: max-entries
key.description: When the history has more entries, Leike removes the oldest entry that is not pinned.

key.name: max-image-bytes
key.description: Leike does not keep an image that is larger than this number of bytes. The default is 10 MiB.

key.name: max-text-bytes
key.description: Leike does not keep a text that is larger than this number of UTF-8 bytes. The default is 1 MiB. A large text makes each save and each load of the history slow.

key.name: terminal-wm-classes
key.description: The WM_CLASS values of terminal windows. Copy, paste and cut send Ctrl+Shift+C, V and X to these windows, and Ctrl+C, V and X to other windows.

key.name: blocklist-wm-classes
key.description: The WM_CLASS values of applications whose clipboard changes Leike does not keep, for example a password manager.

key.name: first-run-done
key.description: True after the extension opened the preferences window at the first enable. The extension opens the window only while this is false.
